page: Microsoft Azure E2s_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ESv3 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8272CL processor operating at 2.6 GHz. The configuration provides 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled, resulting in 2 threads per core. It is equipped with 16.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. The server includes 33 GB of local storage and supports Premium Storage, though it does not include any GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark data indicates that the E2s_v3 exhibits limited processing and memory throughput capabilities. In stress-ng testing, single-core performance is weak, falling in the bottom 25%, while multi-core performance falls into the bottom 10% with a score of 1627.47. Memory bandwidth is also constrained, with large-block read and write speeds measuring 14.08 GB/sec and 11.06 GB/sec respectively, both placing in the bottom 10% of tested systems. Geekbench testing mirrors these results, showing a single-core score of 1058.0 and a multi-core score of 1279.0. These figures highlight a clear tradeoff: while the instance offers a generous memory allocation relative to its vCPU count, its computational and memory transfer speeds are heavily restricted.

Given its high memory density relative to processing power, the E2s_v3 is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require a larger memory footprint but have low CPU demands. It is suitable for small-scale database caching, light relational database instances, basic web serving, or simple background tasks that benefit from 16 GB of RAM without requiring high-throughput computation. However, it is poorly suited for CPU-intensive tasks, large-scale data compiling, real-time ray tracing, or LLM inference, as evidenced by its low benchmark scores in those categories.
description: Microsoft Azure E2s_v3 is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine from the ESv3 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It is configured with 2 vCPUs from a single physical Intel Xeon 8272CL core clocked at 2.6 GHz, 16.0 GB of RAM, and 33 GB of local storage with Premium Storage support. The instance features a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-dependent workloads with low CPU requirements. However, benchmark data reveals significant performance tradeoffs, with both single-core and multi-core CPU performance, as well as memory bandwidth, ranking in the bottom 10% to 25% of tested servers. Consequently, the E2s_v3 is best suited for light database operations, caching, and basic web serving rather than computationally intensive applications.
